```{r}
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)
library(ggpubr)
theme_set(theme_pubr())

readTaxTable <- function(infile, columns = c("TaxProtID", "Name")){
  out.dt <- fread(infile, sep = "\t", header = F, col.names = columns)
  return(out.dt)
}
##### Testing only
Blast.tax.file <- "data/COG1028.80.trim.1.noLong.focalclade.homologs.trim.filter.names.txt"
NOG <- "COG1028"
NOG.tree.file <- "data/COG1028.80.trim.1.fasttree.noLong.tre"
NOG.NR.tree.file <- "data/COG1028.80.trim.1.noLong.focalclade.homologs.trim.filter.noLong.fasttree.tre"
NOG.NR.focal.tree.file <- "data/COG1028.80.trim.1.noLong.focalclade.homologs.selected.trim.1.fasttree.tre"
target <- "330779.Saci_1104"
#####
makePhyPlot <- function(NOG, target, Blast.tax.file, NOG.tree.file, NOG.NR.tree.file, NOG.NR.focal.tree.file){
  library(ggmosaic)
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggpubr)
  theme_set(theme_pubr())
  #read in taxonomy data
  All.tax.dt <- readTaxTable(Blast.tax.file)
  All.tax.dt[,Origin:= "EggNOG"]
  All.tax.dt[grep(Name, pattern = "NCBI\\|"),Origin:= "NCBI"]
  All.tax.dt[, c("Taxonomy","ProtID") := data.table(str_split_fixed(Name,"@",2))]
  All.tax.dt[, c("Domain","Phylum", "Class", "Family", "Genus", "Species") := data.table(str_split_fixed(Taxonomy,"_",6))]
  All.tax.dt[, Species := paste(Genus, Species, sep = " ")]
  setkey(All.tax.dt, "ProtID")
  taxid <- unlist(strsplit(x = target, split = "\\."))[1]
  #read eggnog tree
  NOG.tree <- read.tree(NOG.tree.file)
  print("Working on EggNOG tree.")
  p1 <- ggtree(NOG.tree, layout="equal_angle")
  p1$data$Domain <- All.tax.dt[p1$data$label]$Domain
  p1 <- p1 +
    geom_treescale() +
    geom_tippoint(aes(color = Domain), size = 1, alpha= 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(breaks = c("Archaea", "Bacteria", "Eukaryota"), values = c("#fb9a99","#1f78b4", "#b2df8a")) +
    geom_point2(aes(subset=(label %in% grep(p1$data$label, pattern = taxid, value = T))), fill ="#fb9a99", shape = 25, size =1.5 ) +
    geom_point2(aes(subset=(label %in% target)), fill ="#fb9a99", shape = 25, size =3.5)
  #read eggnog + NR tree
  NOG.tree <- read.tree(NOG.NR.tree.file)
  print("Working on EggNOG+NR tree.")
  p2 <- ggtree(NOG.tree, layout="equal_angle")
  p2$data$Domain <- All.tax.dt[p2$data$label]$Domain
  p2$data$Domain[!p2$data$Domain %in% c("Archaea", "Bacteria", "Eukaryota")] <- NA
  p2$data$Origin <- All.tax.dt[p2$data$label]$Origin
  p2 <- p2 +
    geom_treescale() +
    geom_tippoint(aes(fill = Domain, alpha = Origin, color = Origin), size = 1, shape = 21) +
    scale_fill_manual(breaks = c("Archaea", "Bacteria", "Eukaryota"), values = c("#fb9a99","#1f78b4", "#b2df8a")) +
    scale_alpha_manual(breaks = c("NCBI", "EggNOG"), values = c(0.7,0.5)) +
    scale_color_manual(breaks = c("NCBI", "EggNOG"), values = c("black",rgb(red = 255,green = 255,blue = 255,alpha = 0, maxColorValue = 255))) +
    geom_point2(aes(subset=(label %in% grep(p2$data$label, pattern = taxid, value = T))), fill ="#fb9a99", shape = 25, size =1.5 ) +
    geom_point2(aes(subset=(label %in% target)), fill ="#fb9a99", shape = 25, size =3.5)
  #read in focal tree
  NOG.tree <- read.tree(NOG.NR.focal.tree.file)
  print("Working on Focal tree.")
  p3 <- ggtree(NOG.tree, layout="equal_angle")
  p3$data$Domain <- All.tax.dt[p3$data$label]$Domain
  p3$data$Domain[!p3$data$Domain %in% c("Archaea", "Bacteria", "Eukaryota")] <- NA
  p3$data$Origin <- All.tax.dt[p3$data$label]$Origin
  p3 <- p3 +
    geom_treescale() +
    geom_tippoint(aes(fill = Domain, alpha = Origin, color = Origin), size = 1, shape = 21) +
    scale_fill_manual(breaks = c("Archaea", "Bacteria", "Eukaryota"), values = c("#fb9a99","#1f78b4", "#b2df8a")) +
    scale_alpha_manual(breaks = c("NCBI", "EggNOG"), values = c(0.7,0.5)) +
    scale_color_manual(breaks = c("NCBI", "EggNOG"), values = c("black",rgb(red = 255,green = 255,blue = 255,alpha = 0, maxColorValue = 255))) +
    geom_point2(aes(subset=(label %in% grep(p3$data$label, pattern = taxid, value = T))), fill ="#fb9a99", shape = 25, size =1.5 ) +
    geom_point2(aes(subset=(label %in% target)), fill ="#fb9a99", shape = 25, size =3.5)
  #prepare taxonomy data for plotting
  Selection.tax.dt <- All.tax.dt[ProtID %in% p3$data$label]
  Selection.tax.dt[,Set:= "Focal"]
  All.tax.dt[,Set := "All"]
  All.tax.dt <- rbind(All.tax.dt, Selection.tax.dt)
  All.tax.count.dt<- All.tax.dt[Domain %in% c("Archaea", "Bacteria", "Eukaryota")] %>% count(Origin, Domain,Set)
  Tax.p <- ggplot(All.tax.count.dt)+
    geom_mosaic(aes(x = product(Origin), fill = Domain, weight = n))+
    scale_fill_manual(breaks = c("Archaea", "Bacteria", "Eukaryota"), values = c("#fb9a99","#1f78b4", "#b2df8a")) +
    facet_wrap(~Set) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    ylab("")
    
  figure <- ggarrange(
    p1,
    p2,
    p3 + 
      theme(legend.position = "none"),
    Tax.p,
    ncol = 2,
    nrow = 2,
    labels = c(
      paste("EggNOG n = ",format(length(unique(p1$data[p1$data$isTip == TRUE,]$label)),nsmall=0, big.mark=","), sep = "", collapse = ""),
      paste("EggNOG + NCBI NR n = ",format(length(unique(p2$data[p2$data$isTip == TRUE,]$label)),nsmall=0, big.mark=","), sep = "", collapse = ""),
      paste("Focal clade n = ",format(length(unique(p3$data[p3$data$isTip == TRUE,]$label)),nsmall=0, big.mark=","), sep = "", collapse = ""),
      ""),
    common.legend = TRUE,
    legend = "bottom"
    )
  
  ggsave(figure, filename = paste("results/",NOG,"_plot.pdf", sep = "", collapse = ""), device = "pdf", width = 12, height = 7)
}


NOG <- "COG1028"
Blast.tax.file <- "data/COG1028.80.trim.1.noLong.focalclade.homologs.trim.filter.names.txt"
NOG.NR.focal.treemmer.tree.file <- "../trees/COG1028.80.trim.1.noLong.focalclade.homologs.selected.pruned.combined.trim.40.support.tre"

makeTaxPlot <- function(NOG, Blast.tax.file, NOG.NR.focal.treemmer.tree.file){
  library(ggmosaic)
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(wordcloud2)
  theme_set(theme_pubr())
  #read in taxonomy data
  All.tax.dt <- readTaxTable(Blast.tax.file)
  All.tax.dt[,Origin:= "EggNOG"]
  All.tax.dt[grep(Name, pattern = "NCBI\\|"),Origin:= "NCBI"]
  All.tax.dt[, c("Taxonomy","ProtID") := data.table(str_split_fixed(Name,"@",2))]
  All.tax.dt[, c("Domain","Phylum", "Class", "Family", "Genus", "Species") := data.table(str_split_fixed(Taxonomy,"_",6))]
  All.tax.dt[, Species := paste(Genus, Species, sep = " ")]
  setkey(All.tax.dt, "ProtID")
  taxid <- unlist(strsplit(x = target, split = "\\."))[1]
  #read eggnog tree
  Focal.tree <- read.tree(NOG.NR.focal.treemmer.tree.file)
  Selection.tax.dt <- All.tax.dt[ProtID %in% Focal.tree$tip.label]
  Wordcloud.dt <- Selection.tax.dt[,.(Freq =.N), by= .(Phylum) ]
  print(wordcloud2(Wordcloud.dt, shape ="triangle"))
}
```
